发布到 Bilibili 图文动态，按图片顺序展示正文与配图。: Publish text and images to your Bilibili feed in the selected order.
发布即表示我同意 TikTok 品牌内容政策和音乐使用确认，并确认上传此视频。: By posting, I agree to TikTok’s Branded Content Policy and Music Usage Confirmation, and confirm uploading this video.
发布即表示我同意 TikTok 音乐使用确认，并确认上传此视频。: By posting, I agree to TikTok’s Music Usage Confirmation and confirm uploading this video.
共用视频素材，独立排队和记录结果。: Shares the video and keeps a separate queue and receipt.
共用图片与正文，小红书独立排队。标题最多 20 字，正文最多 1000 字，图片: Share images and text, with a separate Xiaohongshu queue. Titles: 20 characters; text: 1000 characters; images: JPG and PNG.
官方 API 接入，独立上传队列。先在 Google Cloud 启用 YouT: Official API with a separate upload queue. Enable YouTube Data API v3 in Google Cloud, create a Desktop app OAuth client, import its JSON, and authorize in your browser. Credentials are stored in the system vault.
归档 YouTube 频道并保留历史投稿记录？未完成目标须先处理。: Archive this YouTube channel and keep its history? Resolve unfinished targets first.
归档此平台账号并保留历史记录？未完成目标须先处理。: Archive this platform account and retain history? Resolve unfinished targets first.
归档小红书账号并保留历史投稿记录？: Archive the Xiaohongshu account and keep publication history?
检查下载、视频处理和投稿功能是否可用。: Check whether downloading, video processing and publishing are available.
将在所选位置创建与素材库同名的文件夹。: A folder with the library name will be created in the selected location.
仅发布到公共主页（Page）。需 Page Access Token 及 pag: Publishes to a Facebook Page. Requires a Page Access Token with pages_manage_posts and pages_read_engagement permissions.
每条图文动态最多上传 9 张图片。: Each image post supports up to 9 images.
平台仍在处理，请稍后再次核对，不能重新上传。: The platform is still processing. Check again later; do not upload again.
请先到账号与连接登录小红书，登录后可选择同步上传。: Log in to Xiaohongshu in Accounts & connections to enable sync.
请先在“账号与连接”绑定此平台账号。: Connect this platform account in Accounts & Connections first.
请先在“账号与连接”配置并授权 YouTube 频道。: Configure and authorize a YouTube channel in Accounts & Connections first.
请在打开的浏览器中完成小红书登录，安全验证也在网页中完成。: Complete Xiaohongshu login and any security verification in the opened browser.
请在系统浏览器选择目标频道并允许上传和读取权限，授权完成后此处自动更新。: Select your channel and grant upload and read permissions in your browser. This panel updates when authorization completes.
确认账号动态中没有这条图文？: Confirm that this image post is absent from the account feed?
使用官方 API 的用户授权凭据，保存在系统凭据库。网站 Cookie 不能用于: Uses official API user credentials stored in the system vault. Website cookies cannot be used; the account and app need publishing permissions.
视频 / 音频：YouTube、Bilibili、AcFun、抖音、TikTok: Video / audio: YouTube, Bilibili, AcFun, Douyin, TikTok, Xiaohongshu, Weibo, X, Instagram, Facebook, Vimeo, Dailymotion, Twitch, SoundCloud, Bandcamp and other sites.
视频将标记为付费合作。: The video will be labeled as a paid partnership.
视频将标记为推广内容。: The video will be labeled as promotional content.
所选文件夹将作为素材库，素材库名称自动使用文件夹名称。: The selected folder becomes the library, using the folder name as its library name.
添加本地素材，或在任务中心下载素材后点击刷新查看。: Add local materials, or download materials from Tasks and refresh to view them.
同步小红书不支持 GIF，请替换图片或取消同步。: Xiaohongshu sync does not support GIF. Replace the images or turn off sync.
同步小红书时正文不能超过 1000 字，请缩短正文或取消同步。: Xiaohongshu text must not exceed 1000 characters. Shorten it or turn off sync.
图片：Instagram、X、Pinterest、Flickr、Reddit、T: Images: posts on Instagram, X, Pinterest, Flickr, Reddit, Tumblr, DeviantArt, Pixiv and other sites.
图片准备好后，自动提交到所选账号。: Publish to the selected account when images are ready.
图文任务已加入队列。: Image post added to the queue.
推广自己的品牌或业务: Promotes my own brand or business
网络中断不一定代表发布失败。登记动态 ID 会保留本地图片。: A network interruption may still have published the post. Registering its ID keeps local images.
我拥有这些图片与文字的版权或已获得发布授权。: I own the images and text or have permission to publish them.
下载、视频处理和投稿功能已就绪。: Downloading, video processing and publishing are ready.
先核对账号动态，再继续处理: Check the account feed before continuing
小红书图文同步 · 单账号: Xiaohongshu image post sync · One account
校验图片后，由你确认发布。: Review the validated images before publishing.
需 user.info.basic 与 video.publish 授权。Tik: Requires user.info.basic and video.publish scopes. Each TikTok post requires preview and confirmation; public posting depends on app audit and account permissions.
需 X 用户访问凭据，具备 users.read、tweet.read、twee: Requires an X user access token with users.read, tweet.read, tweet.write, and media.write scopes, plus sufficient API access credits.
选择保存视频和封面的文件夹。任务记录和账号设置会单独保存在本机。: Choose a folder for videos and covers. Task records and account settings are saved separately on this computer.
选择或输入封面图片绝对路径: Select a cover image or enter its full local path
也可输入本地图片绝对路径: Or enter an absolute local image path
在浏览器中登录小红书创作中心。图文同步使用独立队列，共用图片与正文；发布时会打开: Log in to Xiaohongshu Creator Center in your browser. Image posts use a separate queue and share images and text. Publishing opens a browser. Chrome or Edge is required.
这是我创作的原创内容: This is original content I created
支持 JPG、PNG、GIF，单张不超过 10 MB。可多选图片，并调整发布顺序: JPG, PNG and GIF, up to 10 MB each. Select multiple images and adjust their order.
支持 JPG、PNG、WebP、BMP；图片会裁剪为 16:9。未选择时自动从视: Supports JPG, PNG, WebP and BMP. Images are cropped to 16:9. Leave empty to use a video frame.
资源监控暂不可用，将自动重试。: Resource monitoring is unavailable. Retrying automatically.
Facebook 标题可单独编辑，简介共用任务简介。上传后仍需等待平台处理视频。: Edit the Facebook title separately. The description is shared with this task. Facebook still needs to process the video after upload.
Google 桌面应用 OAuth JSON 文件的绝对路径: Absolute path to the Google Desktop app OAuth JSON file
TikTok 封面取自视频帧，不能直接使用本任务的独立封面图片。: TikTok selects its cover from a video frame. The separate cover image cannot be used directly.
TikTok 需要逐次预览确认，请切换为预览模式。: TikTok requires preview and confirmation for each post. Switch to preview mode.
X 的文案可单独编辑，字符权重及账号发布限制由平台校验。视频处理完成后才创建帖子: Edit the X caption separately. X checks weighted character counts and account limits. The post is created after video processing completes.
YouTube 标题可单独编辑；简介、标签及封面共用本任务的素材。上传后还需等待: Edit the YouTube title separately. The description, tags, and cover are shared with this task. YouTube still needs to process the video after upload.
YouTube 使用独立队列，共用视频、封面、简介和标签。预览时可单独编辑标题、: YouTube has its own queue and shares the video, cover, description, and tags. Edit its title, category, and visibility in preview.
YouTube 授权已超时，请重试。: YouTube authorization timed out. Please try again.
品牌合作内容不能选择仅自己可见，请重新选择可见性。: Paid partnership content cannot be set to Only me. Choose another visibility option.
